name: ads
description: Search and read synthetic ad data through the ads MCP server.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: A key with search:read scope, created on the developer page (http://localhost:8000/developer). Stored in secure storage, not settings.json.

mcp_url.title: MCP endpoint URL
mcp_url.description: Full URL of the ads MCP endpoint. Change it only if the app does not run on localhost:8000.
